content.hebrew: אֵין עֲרֹךְ לְאֵל יָהּ, וּמַעֲשֵׂה פִלְאוֹ,
content.transliteration: En ‘arokh le’El Yah, uma‘asē fil’o,
content.english: None can compare to God – Yah – and to His wondrous deeds,

content.hebrew: הוּא דָר בְּאֵין מָקוֹם, וְהָעוֹלָם;כְּבוֹדוֹ מְלָאוֹ.
content.transliteration: Hu dar be’en maḳom, veha‘olam kevodo mela’o.
content.english: He dwells in no space, yet His Glory fills the universe.

content.hebrew: רַעְיוֹן כָּל־אֱנוֹשׁ דּוֹם, חֲקוֹר סוֹדוֹ בְּבֹאוֹ.
content.transliteration: Ra‘yon kol enosh dom, ḥaḳor sodo bevo’o.
content.english: Let every human thought be still, when it comes to examine His mystery.

content.hebrew: נִפְלְאֵי דָת לָמַֽדְנוּ מִפִּי נְבִיאוֹ.
content.transliteration: Nifle’ē dat lamadnu mippi nevi’o.
content.english: We learn the wondrous aspects of [His] law from the mouth of His prophet.

content.hebrew: אַחֲרֵי הֱיוֹת מִשְׁכָּן, בֵּין שְׁנֵי כְרוּבִים קְרָאוֹ,
content.transliteration: Aḥarē heyot mishkan, ben shenē kheruvim ḳera’o,
content.english: Once the Tabernacle existed, He called [Moses] between the two cherubim,

content.hebrew: כִּי לֹא יָכוֹל לָבוֹא אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד, כִּי בֶעָנָן מוֹרָאוֹ.
content.transliteration: Ki lo yakhol lavo el ohel mo‘ed, ki ve‘anan mora’o.
content.english: For he was unable to come to the Tent of Meeting, since His tremendum was in the cloud.

content.hebrew: גִּלָּה לוֹ עִנְיַן אֱנוֹשׁ וּמִקְרָאוֹ,
content.transliteration: Gilla lo ‘inyan enosh umiḳra’o,
content.english: He revealed to him the nature of people, and what befalls them,

content.hebrew: כִּי אֵין אָדָם צַדִּיק לְבַל יֶחֱטָא בְּחֶטְאוֹ.
content.transliteration: Ki en adam tsaddiḳ leval yeḥeta beḥet’o.
content.english: For there is no righteous person who does not sin.

content.hebrew: כִּי שְׁתַּֽיִם צוֹמְחוֹת לוֹ, וְהֵם בְּמוֹצָאוֹ וּבְמוֹבָאוֹ,
content.transliteration: Ki shtayim tsomeḥot lo, vehem bemotsa’o uvmova’o,
content.english: For two things grow [in a person], and they accompany him in his comings and goings,

content.hebrew: מִלְּבַד נֵר אֱלֹהִים נִשְׁמַת אָדָם, וּבָהּ נִשְּׂאוֹ.
content.transliteration: Millevad ner Elohim nishmat adam, uvah nisse’o.
content.english: Aside from God’s lamp, the human soul, with which He lifts [people] up.

content.hebrew: הֵן בַּחֲטֹא יַקְרִיב כְּטִבְעוֹ – וְיֵקַל מַשָּׂאוֹ.
content.transliteration: Hen baḥato yaḳriv ketiv‘o – veyeḳal massa’o,
content.english: Behold, upon sinning one should offer a sacrifice in accordance with one’s nature—and one’s burden will be lightened;

content.hebrew: חַי וְצֹמֵֽחַ, לְטַהֲרוֹ אוֹ לְטַמְּאוֹ.
content.transliteration: Ḥai vetsome’aḥ, letaharo o letamme’o.
content.english: Animal and vegetal [components], to make one pure or impure.

content.hebrew: יַחְשׁוֹב דָּמוֹ כְּדָמוֹ וְחֶלְבּוֹ כְּחֶלְבּוֹ, בְּאֵשׁ מְצָאוֹ.
content.transliteration: Yaḥ’shov damo kedamo veḥelbo keḥelbo, be’esh metsa’o.
content.english: One should consider its blood as one’s own, and its fat as one’s own, when one finds it in the fire.

content.hebrew: כִּי קַר וְחַם, לַח וְיָבֵשׁ – בְּמִקְרֶה חַד בְּרָאוֹ.
content.transliteration: Ki ḳar veḥam laḥ veyavesh – bemiḳrē ḥad bera’o.
content.english: For cold and hot, wet and dry—He created them all to coexist.

content.hebrew: תּוֹרָה אַחַת לַכֹּהֵן, וְעֵדָה, וְעַם הָאָֽרֶץ, וּנְשִׂיאוֹ.
content.transliteration: Tora aḥat lakkohen, ve‘eda, ve‘am ha’arets, unsi’o.
content.english: The same instruction applies to the priest, the community, the people of the land, and their prince.

content.hebrew: יִשְׁפּוֹךְ נַפְשׁוֹ לְאֵל אֶחָד בְּרָאוֹ.
content.transliteration: Yishpokh nafsho le’el eḥad bera’o.
content.english: One must pour out one’s soul to the one God, their creator.

content.hebrew: יִשָּׂא לְנַפְשׁוֹ, לְבַל יָשׁוּב בְּנִכְלוֹ, כְּכֶֽלֶב שָׁב עַל קִיאוֹ.
content.transliteration: Yissa lenafsho, leval yashuv benikhlo, kekhelev shav ‘al ḳi’o.
content.english: One must lift up their soul, not to return to their trap, like a dog returning to its vomit.

content.hebrew: כִּי רֽוּחַ שְׁבוּרָה רְצוֹן אֵל, וְלֹא שֶֽׁלֶם מְרִיאוֹ.
content.transliteration: Ki ru’aḥ shevura retson El, velo shelem meri’o.
content.english: For God wants a broken spirit, rather than a shelamim of an ox.
content.comments: Shelamim. A sacrifice whose meat is eaten by the offeror.

content.hebrew: מִנְחַת סֹֽלֶת וּמַחֲבַת וּמֻרְבֶּֽכֶת וּמַרְחֶֽשֶׁת, נְדָבוֹת בַּהֲבִיאוֹ –
content.transliteration: Minḥat solet umaḥavat umurbekhet umarḥeshet, nedavot bahavi’o –
content.english: When one brings a voluntary grain offering of fine flour, or [in] a maḥavath, murbekheth, or marḥesheth,
content.comments: Maḥavath, murbekheth, or marḥesheth. Types of offerings based on the pans used or the method of preparation.

content.hebrew: זֶה דֶּֽרֶךְ יוי בְּהִמָּצְאוֹ.
content.transliteration: Zē derekh Adonai behimmatse’o.
content.english: This is Adonai’s way of being found.

content.hebrew: אַחֲלֵי אֱנוֹשׁ בֶּאֱמֶת יִקְרְאוֹ,
content.transliteration: Aḥalē enosh be’emet yiḳre’o,
content.english: Happy is the person who calls upon Him in truth,

content.hebrew: נַפְשׁוֹ בִּצְרוֹר הַחַיִּים סָבִיב לְכִסְאוֹ,
content.transliteration: Nafsho bitsror haḥayyim saviv lekhis’o,
content.english: Their soul is in the bond of life, around His throne,

content.hebrew: קהל: כִּי קָרוֹב יוי לְכָל־קוֹרְאוֹ.
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ki ḳarov Adonai lekhol ḳore’o.
content.english: Cong. For Adonai is close to all who call upon Him.

content.hebrew: חזן: אַ֤ךְ קָר֣וֹב לִֽירֵאָ֣יו יִשְׁע֑וֹ לִשְׁכֹּ֖ן כָּב֣וֹד בְּאַרְצֵֽנוּ׃ (תהלים פה:י)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Akh ḳarov lire’av yish‘o lishkon kavod be’artsenu:
content.english: Cantor. Indeed, His rescue is close to those who fear Him, such that His Glory will dwell in our land. (Ps. 85:10)

content.hebrew: קהל: בָּר֥וּךְ כְּבֽוֹד־יו֖י מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ: (יחזקאל ג:יב)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Barukh kevod Adonai mimmeḳomo:
content.english: Cong. Blessed is Adonai’s Glory from His place. (Ezek. 3:12)
